feature: Lookup alamat alternatif (lta_reg lalu furnished_mail) saat DataHive tidak mengembalikan alamat FIN
note: findAlternativeAddress memilih alamat lta_reg dengan error_code 0 atau furnished_mail bila alamat DataHive kosong; hasilnya tidak dijadikan default address (tidak ada field di DB, menurut komentar code). Terkait pemilihan alamat tetapi bukan 'tanggal update terbaru' di OCMS8.7; mungkin dimiliki story OCMS8.4. Tidak diklaim di chunk ini.
note_en: findAlternativeAddress picks an lta_reg address with error_code 0 or furnished_mail when the DataHive address is empty; the result is not set as the default address (no field in the DB, per a code comment). Related to address selection but not the 'latest update date' of OCMS8.7; may belong to story OCMS8.4. Not claimed in this chunk.
